items.text: Passwordless passkey sign-in — the fingerprint button runs the WebAuthn ceremony with no email and no password, picking a discoverable credential straight from the authenticator
Login verification chooser: accounts with several second factors pick between authenticator app, emailed one-time code, passkey, or a trusted device
Trusted devices — "remember this device for 30 days" skips two-factor on sign-in, bound to the device profile and revocable from the Security Center
Backup authenticator: enroll a second TOTP device so losing one phone never forces an emailed account recovery
Live mid-market FX pricing from a three-provider chain, with settlement-rail comparison and the cheapest way to pay named on the pricing page
Daily FX rate snapshots with a 30-day trend sparkline on pricing and an in-app alert when a currency moves more than 2% in a day
Recovery readiness is now a 30-day series on the Security Center — a sparkline with honest gaps and a same-day alert the moment coverage drops a rung
Sign out everywhere: one confirmed action revokes every session, every refresh token, and every trusted-device grant, then checks the caller out too
TOTP codes are single-use: an accepted code claims its time step, so replays answer TOTP_REPLAY and are logged as such
Disabling two-factor or removing the last recovery path now requires an explicit, server-enforced acknowledgement that names what you lose
Fixed a token minted after its session was revoked being accepted as legacy — revocation is now fail-closed, proven end-to-end
Fixed the login-throttle window breaking the security-audit hash chain
Fixed a second factor being submittable twice on a slow connection, double-spending the one-time marker
Fixed hydration mismatches from clock and random reads during render, and pinned brand-icon markup byte-equal between server and client
Native QRIS Commerce Suite with instant settlement, Bank Indonesia ASPI compliance, and zero third-party gateway lock-in
10MB multi-format upload engine supporting raw scalable SVG, WebP, AVIF, PNG, and JPG
Automated computerized invoices with vector Code 128 barcodes and interactive visual template customizer
Real-time auto-sensing POS terminal with dedicated Server-Sent Events (SSE) payment stream

faq.q1: How does the multi-channel synchronization work?
faq.a1: Next Dashboard connects directly to your stores across Shopify, TikTok Shop, Shopee, and Tokopedia. All inventory, orders, and customer data sync in real time via secure Webhook and REST API connections, keeping your stock numbers accurate across every channel.
faq.q2: Can I customize the dashboard or integrate custom APIs?
faq.a2: Yes, absolutely. You have full control over the platform. Build custom integrations with our unified REST APIs, configure webhooks for real-time notifications, or tweak the UI components directly to suit your team's exact workflow.
faq.a3: We provide native integrations for Stripe (for global cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay) and Midtrans (for Indonesian virtual accounts, GoPay, OVO, and QRIS payments). Tax calculation and automatic invoicing are fully built-in.
faq.q4: How secure is my data and customer information?
faq.a4: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest with AES-256 and TLS 1.3. We support enterprise security standards including FIDO2 Passkeys, WebAuthn, TOTP two-factor authentication, and append-only cryptographic audit logs for strict compliance.
faq.q5: Is there a free trial available?
faq.a5: Yes, you can get started with our 14-day free trial on the Professional tier with no credit card required. Explore the live analytics, test orders, and multi-channel synchronization instantly.
